Addresses below are INPUTS to the deploy (WETH, matcher, feeReceiver); the deployed contract addresses are written by DeployPerps into broadcast/ receipts and should be recorded back here under `deployed` after a successful (non-dry) run with Reggie's funded key.
_wethNote: Canonical Sepolia WETH9 (reused, not deployed — matches HookSwap CLAUDE.md deploy table). Used as the 18-decimal ETH-denominated collateral and for Settlement.depositETH() auto-wrap.
_matcherNote: REQUIRED before live use. Public address of the off-chain matching-engine relayer (perps-engine) authorized via setAuthorizedMatcher. address(0) => DeployPerps defaults it to the deployer (fine for a Sepolia smoke test, NOT for production). This is a PUBLIC address only — never a private key.
_feeReceiverNote: address(0) => DeployPerps defaults it to the deployer.
_feeRateNote: Per-side trading fee in basis-point-hundredths as used by Settlement (feeRate/10000). 10 = 0.10%. Default from upstream; tune before production.
_supportedTokensNote: Collateral tokens registered via addSupportedToken. Sepolia ships WETH only. Add USDC/USDT test stables here if desired; DeployPerps will register each.

deployed._note: FILLED IN AFTER a real broadcast (Reggie's funded key). Left null in the kit — do NOT fabricate addresses.
